lines.text: Twelve years of doctors. Twelve years of money spent. Twelve years of the same unanswered ache.
She didn't wait for an invitation. She pressed through the crowd for one thing: to touch the hem of His garment.
If I may but touch his clothes, I shall be whole.
And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
Whatever you've been managing instead of healing — stop bumping into God by accident. Reach for Him on purpose.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: If I May But Touch
story: A sun-baked crowd presses in around a solitary figure at midday; close in warm firelight as a trembling hand reaches for the hem of a robe; then a wide gold dawn burst as the woman stands healed, arms lifted to the light - a short illustrated film on Mark 5:27-29, on reaching for Jesus on purpose instead of brushing past Him by accident.
